newsitem.title: USA: US labor mart "very, very strong" - top econ adviser.
newsitem.headline: US labor mart "very, very strong" - top econ adviser.

text.p: Joseph Stiglitz, chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers, said on Monday that a substantially strong U.S. labor market picture has been unfolding.
"The picture of the labor market that has been emerging is very, very strong," said Stiglitz, speaking at a National Association of Business Economists conference.
Stiglitz also said downside risks for the economy included lower exports, due to potential economic weakness in Japan and Europe.
"That is one sense of concern -- that the demand from exports may be weaker than it has been over the last three years," Stiglitz said.

He also said there were signs that the housing sector may be weaker in the third and fourth quarter, but said any resulting slowdown in overall economic growth would not be a threat to the economic expansion.
